finding: high-power test of the prune-soundness guard over 139 wrong-structure pairs. Confirming a structure on the SAME do it will act on is SOUND iff passed_AND_action_unsafe_SAME==0 (a wrong structure that predicts do(k,v) within tol necessarily predicts do(k,v)'s outcome within tol -- tautologically, so the GOAL-CORRECT protocol is: confirm the specific action before taking it). Whether ONE confirmation GENERALIZES to a DIFFERENT action is the separate, non-trivial claim (passed_AND_action_unsafe_DIFFERENT): if >0, a single held-out confirm does NOT license arbitrary actions -> each governed action must be interventionally confirmed on its OWN do. This is the concrete prune-soundness rule: VERIFIED-to-ACT requires confirming the action's own intervention.
